    # Repeat the motif on the side of a solid separator across the other side.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Horizontal separator rows (a full row of one color).
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    if sep_rows:
        # Replicate the rows above the separator downward in the matching area.
        r = sep_rows[0]
        period = r
        if period:
            out = [row[:] for row in grid]
            for rr in range(r + 1, h):
                src = (rr - r - 1) % period
                out[rr] = grid[src][:]
            return out
    if sep_cols:
        c = sep_cols[0]
        period = c + 1
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for cc in range(c + 1, w):
            src = (cc - c - 1) % period
            for rr in range(h):
                out[rr][cc] = grid[rr][src]
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
